76ers 123Raptors 112

Maxey's 27 leads a comeback from 17 down

Final · Thu, Nov 12 · Philadelphia

Philadelphia beat Toronto 123–112, a 11-point home win. The 76ers move to 10–3; the Raptors fall to 5–7.

1 of 7 · The verdict

Won the second and third quarters, 72–54.

Second-quarter points 36–27; third-quarter points 36–27. Toronto had 7 turnovers in the third.

3 of 7 · The moment

Simons at the horn.

Anfernee Simons' 3-pointer at the first-quarter buzzer that cut Toronto's lead from 33-21 to 33-24 and capped an 8-0 Philadelphia run, the start of the comeback from 17 down.
